record.one_liner: Bright Data provides web data collection infrastructure, proxy networks, and APIs authenticated via API keys or native proxy credentials.
record.blocker: Self-serve and shipping access details are not specified in the sources.

auth_methods.quote: Bright Data provides two primary methods for authentication: API Access - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using an API key/token. Native Access - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using proxy protocol username and password .

official_mcp.quote: Agent API keys authenticate the Bright Data MCP server and AI agents. Bright Data lists them in a separate Agent API keys table in Account settings
